description: This file defines an Angular service 'ResourcesService' responsible for loading and managing external resources such as JSON files, scripts, stylesheets, and dynamically imported modules. It includes methods for resource loading, module extraction, and component mapping, with integration to Angular's dependency injection and state management.

classes.name: ResourcesService
classes.description: An Angular service for loading, caching, and managing external resources and modules, including dynamic module import and component extraction.

methods.name: loadJsonResource
methods.description: Loads a JSON resource from a URL with optional post-processing, with caching.

methods.name: loadResource
methods.description: Loads external CSS or JS resources based on URL extension.

methods.name: downloadResource
methods.description: Downloads a resource as a file, handling response headers for filename and content type.

methods.name: loadModulesWithComponents
methods.description: Dynamically loads a module from a URL, extracts its components, and caches the result.

methods.name: extractComponentsFromModule
methods.description: Extracts component types from a loaded module, optionally filtering by instance type and selector case.

methods.name: extractModulesWithComponents
methods.description: Recursively extracts modules and components from a given module object.

methods.name: loadResourceByType
methods.description: Loads a CSS or JS resource into the document dynamically.

methods.name: getDownloadUrl
methods.description: Constructs download URL for a resource based on resource ID.

methods.name: getMetaInfo
methods.description: Provides HTTP headers for resource requests, especially for JS resources.

methods.name: clearModulesWithComponentsCache
methods.description: Clears cached module and component information.
